name: Simulated TTV pair
title: Masses from timing alone (simulated)
notes: Simulated: two transiting warm Saturns just outside the 2:1 resonance, every transit over four years, no velocities. Their O − C curves swing in opposite directions with a period of about 990 days; the N-body fit turns that into both masses. Injected: 0.14 and 0.09 M Jup.
